name: Prism Party
tagline: Turn the mirrors, split the spectrum, light every crystal.
description: A calm, tactile light puzzle. Rotate mirrors and prisms to steer a beam of light around the board and into coloured crystals. White light splits into red, green and blue, filters strip channels away, splitters share one beam between two crystals, portals jump the gap and shutters stay closed until a side beam finds its switch. Two hundred hand-checked puzzles across five rooms, each one verified by a solver, with stars for solving in the fewest turns.
highlights: 200 puzzles, each solved and verified by a backtracking solver before shipping
A real light engine: additive RGB mixing, per-channel transmission, no invented energy
Untimed — experiment freely, with unlimited undo, redo and restart
Three stars per puzzle for solving in the fewest possible turns
Daily puzzle, Zen mode and free play
Keyboard and touch controls, reduced motion and high-contrast options
howToPlay: Tap a mirror or prism to turn it
Steer the beam into every coloured crystal
Prisms separate white light into red, green and blue
Filters strip colours out of a beam — a red crystal needs red light and no blue
Splitters share one beam between two crystals
Every crystal lit at once finishes the puzzle
